sql: SELECT y.trip_date, MAX(CASE WHEN d.d_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN y.trips END) AS target_trips, AVG(CASE WHEN d.d_date IN (DATE '2024-12-07', DATE '2024-12-14', DATE '2024-12-28') THEN y.trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2024-12-07', DATE '2024-12-14', DATE '2024-12-21', DATE '2024-12-28') GROUP BY y.trip_date ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
